ig:
Make.com or n8n for clinic appointment reminders?

Both can do it. The difference is setup, cost model and where patient data lives:
01 Setup: Make.com is hosted; n8n can be cloud or self-hosted
02 Cost: Make bills by usage credits; n8n Cloud counts executions; self-hosted has no per-run fee (check current plans)
03 Data: send only name, time and clinic, never clinical notes
04 Our rule of thumb: small clinic, Make.com; several sites or strict data rules, n8n

Tell us your booking system and volume and we'll recommend one. DM REVIEW.

li:
Build or buy is rarely a one-time decision. It changes as the business grows.

How we think about it with clients:
→ Buy when the process is standard and a tool covers most of it without workarounds
→ Count the hidden costs: per-seat pricing at scale, paid add-ons, and staff time spent on exports and workarounds
→ Build when the process is how you compete, or when you need to own the data and the roadmap
→ Often the right answer is both: keep the SaaS that works, build the piece that connects it

Happy to give a straight opinion on your case: https://xenovasolutions.com/contact
